name: Auth Mock
description: Dev-only root middleware that injects shared-types' MOCK_USER as x-user-context when AUTH_MODE=mock. Real auth providers ship their own middleware that overwrites this one and still honours AUTH_MODE=mock as a dev short-circuit.
checklist: Set AUTH_MODE=mock in development; the middleware injects MOCK_USER from shared-types as x-user-context on every request
MOCK_USER values + runtime overrides (MOCK_USER_NAME / MOCK_USER_EMAIL / MOCK_USER_ROLES / MOCK_USER_AVATAR_URL) live in shared-types
A real auth provider template overwrites this middleware with its own and still honours AUTH_MODE=mock as a dev short-circuit
